kjv: precept upon precept ... line upon line
note: Hebrew tsaw latsaw qaw laqaw is most likely mocking babble, the drunken leaders imitating the prophet's "baby-talk", answered in v. 11 by foreign speech; the KJV makes it a commendation of step-by-step teaching, as it is now often quoted.
Hebrew qetsach is black cumin or dill (Nigella sativa) and kussemet is emmer wheat; rye did not grow in ancient Israel.
